# implement-spec ledger — P10.2 The detector catalog

- **spec:** docs/tickets/P10.2__detector-catalog.md
- **base commit:** a95fa638422f5866756d1756a354a4a1626d1291 (branch devin/p10-1-task-engine)
- **branch:** devin/p10-2-detector-catalog

## Requirements (from spec + §33.2 / §31)
- R1 (SIG-TASK-003): full 34-type §33.2 catalog, each registered against P10.1 DSL with versioned detector + testable closing_condition. A type without a testable closing cannot register.
- R2 (SIG-TASK-004): every §31 contradiction detector (contradiction_type vocabulary, 9 members in reconcile.model.CONTRADICTION_TYPES) maps to a catalog task type.
- R3: per-type detector fixtures — fires on positive, quiet on negative, auto-invalidates (TaskPool.sweep_invalidations) when condition clears.
- R4 (phase gate §51.3): make check green; automated tests; ADR for deviation; traceability updated; risk register updated.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: all 34 §33.2 task types implemented, each testable closing; count authority = §33.2 (34). deterministic.
- AC2: every contradiction detector maps to a task; test asserts no §31 detector without a task type. deterministic.
- AC3: each detector has positive/negative fixture + auto-invalidation. deterministic.
- AC4: phase gate — CI green, tests, ADR, traceability, risk register.

## Out of scope
- The engine (P10.1). Records-request/statute templates (P10.3, §36). Contradiction detection logic (P08.3, §31) — only map, don't re-implement.

## Plan / targets
- New module tasks/src/tasks/catalog.py (the 34 TaskTypes + build_catalog() + CONTRADICTION_TASK_MAP).
- Export from tasks/__init__.py.
- New tests tests/tasks/test_tasks_catalog.py.
- Docs: ADR (deviation), traceability P10.2 block, risk register P10.2 block.
- Verify: uv run ruff check / format / mypy -p tasks / pytest tests/tasks tests/reconcile; then make check.
